findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-term credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration or Terraform state, and risking leakage via logs or console access.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a deprecated Node.js runtime no longer receiving security updates from AWS, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
